recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It aligns the active profile with the accepted R5 subscription-notification design and current examples without changing base Bundle invariants or reopening the older history-bundle workaround decision.
issue_request: FHIR-23859 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested Bundle support for subscription notifications, including full-resource payloads with request/response details and id-only payloads, with reconstructed Jira resolution text initially saying to use history bundles and relax constraints.
initial_application: The issue was effectively applied during the R5 subscription redesign as a first-class Bundle.type = subscription-notification rather than by retaining history as the notification type. Commit a8762c404cabbf352bfaa710016d436b85b757b9 added subscription-notification Bundle spreadsheet rules allowing entry.request and entry.response for that type, and a0abf4b1705a30f48541089896d3335ae9b6bd5b added Bundle narrative. A later Bundle profile introduced a max=0 restriction on Bundle.entry:other.response, creating the remaining inconsistency fixed here.
additional_context: FHIR-23738 records the R5 Argonaut subscription branch application of FHIR-23859: add subscription-notification, allow request and response for that type, and require SubscriptionStatus as the first entry. Current Bundle source and code system contain the type and bdl-13. Current Subscription guidance and examples still allow or use entry.response in subscription-notification payload entries, and the profile is in build scope through the active Bundle resource and Bundle-core implementation guide.
reconciliation: Removed the Bundle.entry:other.response max=0 element from source/bundle/structuredefinition-profile-subscription-notification-bundle.xml. The first SubscriptionStatus entry remains constrained to omit response, while additional entries inherit base Bundle response cardinality.
source_changes: source/bundle/structuredefinition-profile-subscription-notification-bundle.xml: removed the max=0 restriction on Bundle.entry:other.response so additional subscription-notification entries can carry response details.
